::: {#def-full-conditional}
#### Full conditional distribution

For a parameter vector $\vth = (\theta_1, \ldots, \theta_K)$,
the **full conditional distribution** of the component $\theta_k$
is its conditional distribution given the data and all the other components,
$\p(\theta_k \mid \vth_{-k}, \vy)$,
where $\vth_{-k}$ denotes every component of $\vth$ except $\theta_k$.
:::
